title: A fresh zero sensor reading is replaced by an older fallback
description: A fresh zero sensor reading is replaced by an older fallback
taskPrompt: A resolver prefers the current sensor when it has a reading and uses a fallback only when the current source is unavailable. Normal positive readings work, but a legitimate zero is replaced by an older fallback value. Restore source selection without changing provider return shapes.
expectedBehavior: Agent completes the requested behavior and passes independent hidden validation
